# vouchfx

> vouchfx is an end-to-end integration testing framework that compiles declarative
> `.e2e.yaml` tests into Turing-complete C#, runs them through Roslyn, and orchestrates
> the required container topology with .NET Aspire and Testcontainers. It is built on
> .NET but tests distributed systems written in any language — Java, Kotlin, Python,
> Go, Node.js — running as containers, proving one business transaction end-to-end
> across a REST call, a Kafka event, a database mutation and an outbound webhook.

## Start here

- [Getting started](https://vouchfx.io/getting-started/): a 60-minute path from a ready environment to your first PASS verdict.
- [Recipes](https://vouchfx.io/recipes/): task-oriented, runnable patterns — SQL seeding, test doubles, secrets, capture/substitution, RETRY polling.
- [Common patterns](https://vouchfx.io/common-patterns/): the structural shapes most `.e2e.yaml` files share.
- [Troubleshooting](https://vouchfx.io/troubleshooting/): real failure modes and how to fix them.
- [Security compatibility matrix](https://vouchfx.io/security-matrix/): which authenticated infrastructure a 1.0 suite can reach over TLS or mutual TLS, and which it cannot.

## Design docs

- [Technical Architecture & Engineering Blueprint](https://vouchfx.io/01_Technical_Architecture_and_Engineering_Blueprint/): the single source of truth for how the engine is built.
- [YAML DSL Specification & VSCode Extension](https://vouchfx.io/02_YAML_DSL_Specification_and_VSCode_Extension_Design/): the `.e2e.yaml` grammar and editor tooling.
- [Language reference](https://vouchfx.io/language-reference/): every field, generated from the composed JSON Schema the compiler validates against.

## Operating vouchfx

- [Telemetry & privacy](https://vouchfx.io/telemetry/): the privacy-first, opt-in telemetry design.
- [The memory-leak harness](https://vouchfx.io/memory-harness/): the heap-measurement tool behind the permanent CI memory-safety gate.
- [Accessibility](https://vouchfx.io/accessibility/): the WCAG 2.1 AA conformance record for the report renderers.
- [KB: DCP orchestrator not found](https://vouchfx.io/kb/dcp-orchestrator-portability/): an incident write-up — symptom, root cause, resolution.

## Project

- [The ecosystem](https://vouchfx.io/ecosystem/): the five vouchfx repositories, what each is for, and where its site lives.
- [Roadmap](https://vouchfx.io/roadmap/): what has shipped, what is next, and what stays free permanently.
- [Changelog](https://vouchfx.io/changelog/): the delivered-capability record.
- [Governance](https://vouchfx.io/governance/): how providers earn the Vouched badge and how disputes are resolved.
- [Project README](https://vouchfx.io/project-readme/): what vouchfx is, how it works, and the repository layout.
